audit_question: Is database integrity verifiable in this audit environment?
audit_answer: UNKNOWN — no live DB access. Schema present, migrations absent (intentional), schema drift untestable, zero-data-loss check NOT_APPLICABLE because no data exists to lose.

prisma_schema_state.datasource_block: TURSO_DATABASE_URL (env); provider = "sqlite"; note: DATABASE_BACKEND env var switches to Neon Postgres fallback at runtime per src/lib/db.ts (commit 9a97cae)

migrations_state.reason: Project uses db:push workflow (per worklog P48-58 operating-phase entries), NOT migration workflow. This is an intentional design choice, not a defect. Migration history is not available for audit; migration reproducibility is not verifiable — but this is by design.
migrations_state.recovery_recommendation: RECONSTRUCTABLE — operator may generate migrations from current schema via `bunx prisma migrate dev --name init` if migration-based workflow is desired. NOT required for production authorization if db:push is operator-approved.

schema_drift_state.reason: Cannot test schema drift without live DB access. No TURSO_DATABASE_URL or NEON_DATABASE_URL provisioned (BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_SECRET). Cannot run `prisma migrate diff` against live DB. Cannot verify whether the committed schema.prisma matches the live DB schema.
schema_drift_state.remediation: Operator must provision TURSO_DATABASE_URL + NEON_DATABASE_URL, then run `bunx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-url $TURSO_DATABASE_URL` to verify drift.

zero_data_loss_check.reason: No live DB exists in this audit environment. No data exists to lose. The check is conceptually vacuous here: data loss requires pre-existing data; we have none.
zero_data_loss_check.production_zero_data_loss_check: Will be applicable AFTER operator provisions secrets, applies schema via `bunx prisma db push`, and runs Pilot A. Until then: NOT_APPLICABLE.

destructive_operations_check.summary: No destructive DB operations performed in any phase. No `prisma migrate reset`, no `db drop`, no `db push --force-reset`, no `TRUNCATE`, no `DELETE FROM`. The only DB-related operations were: schema.prisma file inspection (read-only).

database_integrity_verdict.overall: UNKNOWN_INTEGRITY — schema is present and unchanged; but live DB integrity cannot be verified without runtime.
